entries.03b713874499011b: This business earns revenue mainly from users' payments for purchases (or trials) of products, through the company's own operation of the trial service "Sample Hyakkaten" and the joint operation of NTT Docomo's general online shopping site "d Shopping" and the hometown tax donation portal "d Shopping Furusato Nozei Hyakusen." The main revenue of Sample Hyakkaten is the "trial fee" that users pay for products procured from manufacturers and wholesalers and listed on the service. At d Shopping, the company is involved in planning and operating EC services that use NTT Docomo's customer base and d Points, and earns a fixed rate of the transaction volume (the total amount purchased by users) as revenue. Sample Hyakkaten has about 4.3 million cumulative users, and the annual securities report states that the consolidated subsidiary that operates it, All About Life Marketing Co., Ltd. (the company holds 100.0% of its voting rights), is opening physical stores. The annual securities report discloses the amount for this business only as the Consumer Services segment.

The securities report states that this business grew in the fiscal year ended March 2026. The securities report discloses this business's amount only as the Marketing Solutions segment.
entries.48016ca98aab39ed: This reportable segment provides services mainly to general consumers, including the company's own operation of the trial service "Sample Hyakkaten," which the annual securities report describes as "one of the largest in Japan," and the joint operation of NTT Docomo's general online shopping site "d Shopping." Of the 2 reportable segments, it has the larger sales to external customers. For the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales to external customers were ¥13,175 million (down 4.9% from the previous fiscal year) and segment profit was ¥363 million (down 28.4% from the previous fiscal year). The annual securities report states that sales fell because Sample Hyakkaten was affected by product procurement shortages caused by supply chain issues, and because of stronger promotions by EC platform operators in Japan and overseas. It also states that the segment widened its customer contact points through physical Sample Hyakkaten stores in the Tokyo metropolitan area and a store on "Yahoo! Shopping," and that on the cost side it invested toward migration to a next-generation system.

The securities report states that although sessions on the comprehensive information site "All About" decreased owing to changes in the search environment caused by AI, programmatic advertising unit prices remained firm thanks to a shift toward high-unit-price content, the Global Marketing Business grew as commissions for inbound marketing measures, mainly from government agencies and local governments, expanded, and the Digital Marketing Business also increased its sales. The main businesses of Mirai Bank Co., Ltd. (bank agency business and provision of financial information services; the Company's ownership of voting rights: 100.0%), which became a consolidated subsidiary when all of its shares were acquired on May 26, 2025, are also printed as the bank agency business. The notes on business combinations state that, through a partnership with Sumishin SBI Net Bank, Ltd., it provides various financial products and services under the "Mirai Bank" brand, and that its main source of revenue is fees from home loans. The table of segment information for the previous fiscal year has no "Other" column, and its revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 is smaller than that of either of the two reportable segments. Because it is not included in the reportable segments, it is placed last regardless of the order of revenue.
entries.efd451872528c61c: This business earns revenue from advertising on the internet media operated by the group and from providing various digital marketing solutions. The core general information site "All About" is a site where 900 experts called "Guides" publish information with their face photos, names and profiles, across 1,300 fields including housing and real estate, money, health and medical care, beauty, digital, living, business, gourmet and travel. Besides editorial advertising (editorial-style advertising and tie-up advertising) that draws on the editing know-how built through article production, it earns revenue from banner advertising, video advertising and other formats. It operates "Facebook navi," which the annual securities report describes as "the only Facebook-authorized navigation site in Japan," and "Tsuinavi," a navigation site for X, supporting marketing that uses SNS; it also earns revenue from "PrimeAd," a platform that advances DX in the advertising industry, performance-based advertising, advertising operation support and content sales.
